verses.1: The LORD, the king, will make the earth shine; many nations will rejoice.
verses.2: The clouds and darkness around him represent righteousness and justice. They serve as a foundation for his throne.
verses.3: Fire will go before him, and it will burn around his feet.
verses.4: Their lamps shone in Egypt. She saw it, and the earth began to shine.
verses.5: The mountains of Kadoan were destroyed before Jehovah’s eyes, before Adonai, throughout all the land.
verses.6: May the heavens speak righteousness, and may all nations see its glory.
verses.7: May all those who worship the idols be cursed! May all the gods be disgraced.
verses.8: She heard and was glad; Zion rejoiced, and the daughters of Judah praised you for your judgments, O LORD.
verses.9: For you, LORD, are exalted above all nations; you have been honored above all gods.
verses.10: The lovers of Jehovah hate evil. They protect the lives of their faithful people from the hands of the wicked. They save them.
verses.11: Light for the righteous and for those with a pure heart, who will be joyful.
verses.12: Rejoice, righteous people, in the Lord! Praise Him, so that His holiness may be remembered.
